title: feat(objectql): tool names held per namespace, not per deployment (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TryC4aVXRY5tzUg9kGkBo4)_
Fixes #31985

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

> **Draft condition (epic seat).** This PR leaves draft only on a fresh cloud reading that answers **no** to both questions of the epic seat's request 6760281500 on #31366 (does the cloud resolve a package `tool` record by bare name, and does anything in the cloud read package `tool` records at all). If either answer is yes, this PR is `Blocked-by` the cloud change that resolves them by package. The current evidence is the two dated cloud readings recorded in `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` (cloud `@15f55df`, 2026-08-29, and cloud `@cb62c3ea`, 2026-10-02, by the repo:cloud seat on #20274: "an authored tool record never becomes a tool definition").
>
> **Landing order.** After seat 1's #31696, #31697 and #31699, then #31700, each of which edits `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`. This branch merges `origin/main` after each of them lands (merge, never rebase).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：工具（tool）的同名规则从「整个部署只能有一个包持有」放宽到「每个命名空间一个」，和 agent、skill 一样。两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各带一个同名工具。
- 为什么改：这是 ADR-0150 第 14 个 B 卡。包里的 tool 记录在开源仓只有 `/meta/tool/NAME` 一个按名读取的地方，它已经按包解析，所以可以放宽。
- 风险与回滚：同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、base/system/sys、内置名照旧被拒，原句不变。回滚就是把 `tool` 从集合里删掉这一行。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`（集合加一项）、`registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`、`packages/spec/liveness/tool.json`（给云端加的前置条件）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts -t tool`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（等云端读数回来后才离开 draft）。

## What changes

- `packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`: `tool` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, so `bareNameHoldersMeet` lets two package holders of two declared namespaces each hold one tool name at the package door (`installPackage`), the item seam (`registerItem`) and the cold-boot seal. The module doc says why `tool` qualifies (its one by-name reader already resolves by package; it has no AI face to carry), and records the cloud precondition. `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES.tool` stays empty (census below).
- `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` (`_note` only; the one `packages/spec` edit the epic seat allowed, claim amendment 6760298444): the precondition on the first reader of a package `tool` record.
- `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__bare-name-one-holder.ts.json`: the invariant names `tool` beside agent and skill.
- `.changeset/31985-tool-names-per-namespace.md` (`@objectstack/objectql` minor).

Still refused, each with today's envelope and sentence: a co-owner of the holder's namespace (for a tool that is the namespace co-owner rule's `NamespaceNameConflictError`, child N, which judges a tool ahead of this rule at every install, boot included, exactly as before this change), a package with no namespace beside any holder, two packages of one shareable namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), and a built-in name.

## Why

ADR-0150 D9 narrows a type's one-holder refusal once its by-name readers, its AI face and its stored references carry the package. Step 0 (`/mnt/project-files/server-seat2/31985-step0.md`, read at `origin/main` `48f18b58`) measured all three for `tool`; the seat ruled the card ships as this one narrowing PR (claim amendment 6760255704: Q1 = A, no `Part of` PR; Q2 = A, built-in census 0).

### Readings (a)–(d)

- **(a) Face (D6).** No surface in this repo shows a package `tool` record to a model or an MCP client. The MCP stdio bridge (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `bridgeTools`) lists the AI service's live `ToolRegistry`, whose `AIToolDefinition` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`) carries no package and is minted from platform code and actions, never from a `tool` record. HTTP MCP never bridges that registry. Skill prompts do not project `tools[]`. Agent tool binding is cloud-only (`ai/skill.zod.ts`: CLOUD-RUNTIME-ONLY).
- **(b) Caller references (D3).** `agent.tools` was removed in spec 17; tools reach an agent only through its skills (ADR-0064). A skill's `tools[]` is resolved only by the cloud runtime, against its live registry; the spec calls a `stack.tools` record "inert". The static R7 lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`) is per stack and never environment-wide. The one runtime by-name reader, `/meta/tool/NAME`, resolves by `(package, name)` since E8 #31680, and the G1 qualified door `/meta/tool/NS/NAME` reaches each holder.
- **(c) Stored references.** D8 has no `tool` row; S4's report rows (`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`) hold 0 `tool` rows. First-party tool records in `examples/`: 0, so the stored-references report has no tool row to name on the dogfood or app-crm; the S4 integration fixture now carries a two-namespace tool name and pins that the sealed-clash section does not list it.
- **(d) Built-in names.** Platform-requested tool names in the D3 sense (`PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE`): **0**. The 41 platform-provided names (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`) live in the AI service's registry, not this registry, and are not refused (seat ruling Q2 = A), so nothing new narrows.

### In-repo pins this relies on

- `/meta/tool/NAME` read by package: `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (E8 #31680, `tool` in `E8_TYPES`).
- The `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` answer, naming both holders, on a bare `/meta/tool/NAME` read with two holders: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` ("the bare by-name read refuses 409 naming both holders; `?package=` serves each package's own", which covers `tool`), and in-process the new `[#31985]` pin through `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem`.

## Carried to repo:cloud

Once tool records stop being inert (cloud Phase 2), or any cloud change first reads a package `tool` record: that reader **must** resolve a name from the referring item's own package (its own record, else the unique holder in its declared dependency closure, ADR-0150 D3), **must** refuse a name two packages hold, naming every candidate, and must never take the first one registered, never reach a tool outside that closure, and never reach a tool only the environment holds. The same obligation is written into `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` as a precondition of that change.

## Tests

Forced test edits (each pinned the old rule):

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: #31973's `tool` CONTROL ("a tool has not narrowed") flipped into the narrowing pin (two namespaces install; each package's caller is served its own; the bare read refuses 409 naming both). `tool` joins `NARROWED`, so the full narrowing matrix runs for it. The matrix rival for a tool is a package with **no namespace** (an agent's and a skill's stays a co-owner), because the namespace co-owner rule refuses a tool's co-owner first; the two co-owner cases of the matrix register for agent and skill only, and two new pins hold the tool co-owner on that rule's envelope at the package door and through the cold boot.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold boot of two namespaces' tool holders now logs no bare-name warning (was one line naming the tool); the qualified-read pin covers `tool`; the "held tool name is refused naming both holders" install-local case is replaced by a third-namespace tool that installs and a co-owner tool that is refused on the namespace co-owner rule's sentence.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: the fixture's two namespaces also share a tool name, and the sealed-clash section still lists only the picklist.

Ablation (predicate): `tool` removed from `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `84e89a25` → `53261bd3`); `vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts -t tool` went red, 7 failed (the switch pin, the two-namespace install pin, the item-seam pin, the cold-boot pin, the `[#31985]` resolve pin and both co-owner pins, whose setup installs two namespaces); restored to blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `NAMESPACE_UNIQUE_TYPES` (child N) still lists `tool`, so a tool's same-namespace co-owner is refused by N's sentence, not this rule's. That is today's answer, unchanged; noted so a reader of the matrix knows why the tool's rival differs.
- The 41 platform-provided tool names are not built-ins here; if a later change makes package tool records reach the AI service's registry, that change owns the name clash with them.

## Verification

Head `c3d90f1c` (branch on `origin/main` `ff04ad81`, 0 commits behind at open). Every run below is on this head.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck && vitest run`: typecheck clean; Test Files 584 passed (584), Tests 12036 passed (12036). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 8 passed (8). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: Tests 9 passed (9). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation of the predicate: 7 tool pins red, restored to HEAD (see Tests).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the four touched source and test files: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 79 families at `c3d90f1c`; all 79 ran, each exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET exit 3, then exit 0 after a full `pnpm build`). `--ran` reconciliation: "79 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 79 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

Not run locally, declared to CI: the full dogfood battery (no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm), `test:repo`, and the CI-only families outside the derived list.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (the edit is a liveness `_note`; `check:liveness` green, no generated artifact reads it).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
